defective_pattern: Using mechanical, copy-pasted boilerplate text for multiple hypotheses (e.g., Hypotheses 3 to 8) instead of authentic narrative.
why_defective: Violates Directive 25 (Universal Anti-Shortcut, Proper Execution Invariant) and reduces doctoral-level academic writing to formulaic, robotic text.
observed_symptoms: Identical paragraph structures with only numbers or variable names swapped out for multiple hypotheses.
corrective_remedy: Generate authentic, contextually rich psychological narrative for every hypothesis instead of looping through formulaic templates, adhering strictly to Directive 25.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect identical or highly similar sentence structures repeating across hypothesis sections.
